scope.output: Music Braille semantic emission plan; BRF-to-Unicode cell conversion remains Phase 14.6

normativeBoundary.authoritativeMusicRules: BANA Music Braille Code 2015 seed materialized in Phase 14.5b
normativeBoundary.midiSpecificPolicies: Project profile decisions required because MIDI does not preserve print notation semantics
normativeBoundary.statement: The MIDI profile produces a deterministic transcription from sounding/structural MIDI data; it does not claim recovery of the original printed spelling, clef, hand, or engraving choices.

candidateSelection: Generate every letter/accidental candidate whose sounding pitch class equals the MIDI pitch class.
For each letter, compute its default accidental under the active MIDI key signature.
Minimize absolute distance from that key-signature accidental first; this preserves diatonic spellings such as E-sharp in seven-sharp signatures and F-flat in six-flat signatures.
Then prefer the active key polarity: sharps for positive sf, flats for negative sf, sharps as the deterministic tie-break when sf is zero or absent.
Use stable letter order C,D,E,F,G,A,B as the final tie-break.
enharmonicSpelling.octaveRule: After spelling is chosen, derive the written octave from the spelled letter plus accidental while preserving the original MIDI sounding pitch. Do not derive the Braille octave solely from pitch-class arithmetic because spellings such as B-sharp/C-flat can cross a C boundary.

tieBreakCorrection.reason: Makes KEY_SIGNATURE_DISTANCE_V1 executable semantics agree with the already-frozen F-flat/G-flat-major profile fixture.

chordProfile.reason: MBC 2015 normally derives written-note choice and interval direction from print clef/part context; MIDI does not carry that context.
chordProfile.ordering: Sort chord members by sounding pitch descending; emit the highest note as the written note and encode remaining members as descending diatonic intervals relative to it.
chordProfile.futureAdapterOverride: A future adapter with explicit print semantics (for example MusicXML in Phase 19) may supply a documented clef/part-directed policy without changing the Music Braille engine boundary.
chordProfile.tiePolicy: Use the chord-tie rule when more than one chord member is tied; use single ties for individual tied notes/intervals where required by the authoritative tie rules.

keySignature.oneToThree: Repeat the authoritative sharp or flat sign abs(sf) times.
keySignature.fourToSeven: Emit the numeric count including numeric indicator, followed immediately by one authoritative sharp or flat sign.

meterSignature.input: Simple numerator/denominator derived from MIDI time-signature metadata
meterSignature.serialization: Numeric indicator + upper-cell numerator numeral(s), followed unspaced by lower-cell denominator numeral(s), according to MBC 2015 meter-signature procedure.
meterSignature.commonAndCutTime: DO_NOT_INFER_FROM_MIDI; serialize MIDI 4/4 and 2/2 numerically because MIDI does not preserve whether print used common/cut-time symbols.

encoderStateAndPrecedence.measureBoundary: Reset measure-scoped accidental state; emit the authoritative normal measure separator.
encoderStateAndPrecedence.signatureOrder: If present at the same score position, emit key signature before meter signature; no blank is inserted between an immediately adjacent key and meter signature.
encoderStateAndPrecedence.nextNoteAfterSignature: Force octave mark after key or meter signature.
